tasks.short: Compare positions and manage the plan.

steps.what: Compare stored positions with the client plan
Manage client portfolios, keeping the plans current
Decide any change only in the signed note
Sign the portfolio note
File the signed portfolio note
outputs: filed copy of signed portfolio note v1

tasks.design: A job in {BI} compares each stored position with the client plan and draws no chart by hand. The advisor manages the portfolio and keeps the plan current. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not place a trade.
tasks.previous_blocker: Positions were compared by hand before the plan was updated.
tasks.enabler_now: Position identifier, position amount, and plan amount are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The decision to change a holding stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides whether the plan still fits.

ambition.what: Sign the portfolio note the day a stored position and the plan differ.

tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the portfolio, not on drawing the comparison.

reach.task: Act only on the portfolio note the advisor signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says these figures are plain code and configuration in the ledger.
The executive digest says dashboards replace drawing charts.
Digest [S10] says most models in a published test ended a cash waterfall at the wrong figure. This design checks every figure against a source row.

assumptions: Position identifier, position amount, and plan amount are stored on the portfolio record. The portfolio record produces them. A difference is shown only when both amounts are stored. A blank amount is not treated as zero. The job does not place a trade and does not score the client.
Native configuration of the portfolio record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor managing client portfolios and keeping the plans current.

incremental.description: Refresh position identifier, position amount, and plan amount when the portfolio layout changes, and drop a note the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many position amounts are blank. The high end assumes position amount and plan amount are both stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored cash and insurance facts with no score
Recommend to clients strategies in cash management
Recommend insurance coverage and investment planning
Sign the strategy recommendation
File the signed strategy recommendation
outputs: filed copy of signed strategy recommendation v1

tasks.design: A job in {ERP} lists stored facts for cash, insurance, and investments and writes no score. The advisor recommends strategies in cash management, insurance coverage, investment planning, or other areas for the client's financial goals. A later job files the signed recommendation in {DOCS}. It does not price life or health insurance and it does not rank a product.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recommendations were made without the stored facts beside them.
tasks.enabler_now: Fact identifier and fact text are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The recommendation stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides which strategy fits the goal.
tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the recommendation, not on listing facts.

reach.task: Hear only the recommendation the advisor signed

evidence.claim: Digest [S12] says credit scoring of natural persons is high-risk, and life and health insurance pricing is high-risk. This design does not score a client and does not price insurance.
Digest [S13] says the high-risk duties apply from 2 December 2027.
Digest [S15] says a score is an automated decision when the lender gives it a determining role. This design does not produce a score.
The executive digest says firms fall outside and sole traders do not. This design does not score a client either way.
The executive digest says interviews, debt advice, and declining excessive risk stay with people.

assumptions: Fact identifier and fact text are stored on the plan record. The plan record produces them. A blank fact is not filled by a guess. The list is not a score of the client and not a price of life or health insurance.
Native configuration of the plan record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor recommending strategies in cash management.

incremental.description: Refresh fact identifier and fact text when the fact layout changes, and drop a recommendation the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many fact texts are blank. The high end assumes fact identifier and fact text are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.short: Implement or refer, and file the note.

steps.what: List the signed recommendation awaiting action
Implement financial planning recommendations in person
Refer clients to someone who can assist them
Sign the implementation note
File only the signed implementation note
outputs: filed copy of signed implementation note v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists a recommendation only when that recommendation was already signed. The advisor implements it or refers the client to someone who can assist. A later job files only the signed implementation note. It does not place a trade and it does not message the other person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Implementation started before the advisor had decided to refer.
tasks.enabler_now: Recommendation identifier and recommendation text are already stored from an earlier signed note.
tasks.still_hard: The choice to implement or refer stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides who, if anyone, should assist.
tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the work, not on listing recommendations.

reach.task: Proceed only on the note the advisor signed

evidence.claim: The advisor implements or refers. The job does not place a trade and does not message another person.

assumptions: Recommendation identifier and recommendation text are stored on the plan record once the advisor has signed that earlier recommendation. The plan record produces them. A blank recommendation is not implemented. The job does not place a trade and does not message another person.
Native configuration of the plan record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor implementing financial planning recommendations.

incremental.description: Refresh recommendation identifier when the plan layout changes, and drop an implementation note the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many recommendation texts are blank. The high end assumes recommendation identifier and recommendation text are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

role.altitude: The advisor spends the week with the client and on the signed note. A stored ratio, a missing-field list, and filing that signature can move. The advisor still interviews, recommends, and decides.
reach: A client receives only the text the advisor signed.
A creditor is paid only the disbursement the advisor signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a ratio that treats a blank figure as zero.
Reject a report whose figure has no source row.
Reject a payment the advisor has not signed.
role.ambitious_version: A signed plan note can be filed the same day, and the advisor still decides the strategy.
